body: FAERYL VICONIA, queen of the Unseelie winter court, leader of the Svartalfar in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: dark elf; female; ageless, looking about thirty; tall and slender. Pale ash-grey skin, straight silver-white hair falling past long pointed ears, narrow violet eyes.
costume: a high-collared gown of deep purple velvet with black lace and silver spiderweb embroidery, a mantle of black fur.
signature: Her tall black-and-silver CROWN SHAPED LIKE ARCHED SPIDER LEGS rises from her silver hair.
extra: In every portrait she hides a slim silver STILETTO with a small spider-shaped pommel where the viewer can see it and the person she is smiling at cannot; it lies flat and still, pointing at no one and never toward the viewer, with no blood anywhere. Whatever her mouth does, her violet eyes stay cold and still.

vibes.name: Velvet Venom
vibes.line: Raising a glass of pale wine in a gracious toast with her right hand, smiling at a guest across the table; her left hand on the tablecloth, the stiletto up inside its black lace cuff, its spider pommel showing at her wrist on the viewer's side; candlelit dinner at night.
vibes.wears: a high-collared evening gown of deep purple velvet with long black lace cuffs and silver spiderweb embroidery, amethysts at her throat.

vibes.name: Winter Crown
vibes.line: A Seelie envoy walking ahead, unaware; her left hand holding a white fur muff shut on his side, her right inside it on the stiletto's spider hilt, the open end toward the viewer; a small cold smile straight at the viewer, frost on her crown; black trees, moonlit silver snow.
vibes.wears: her winter furs: a long hooded mantle of white winter fox, the hood down, over a silver-grey brocade gown, frost-white lace at the throat.

vibes.name: Spider's Court
vibes.line: Holding a black lace fan open before her lower face in her right hand, the stiletto along its ribs on the viewer's side; her left hand given to a bowing courtier's kiss, eyes down through her lashes; her throne hall at dusk, courtiers caught in silver web shadows, violet witch-light.
vibes.wears: a stiff formal court gown of black silk with a vast standing collar of silver spiderweb lace, fine silver threads like web strands trailing from her sleeves.

vibes.name: Knife Smile
vibes.line: Pouring tea for her cousin across a small table with her right hand, her warmest smile on the cousin; her left hand in her lap below the tablecloth, holding the stiletto flat and sideways, hidden from the cousin, not from the viewer; a winter-palace window alcove, pale morning snow-light.
vibes.wears: a soft, harmless-looking day gown of pale rose silk with tiny pearl buttons and a cream lace shawl, chosen to look kind.
